note: ao_id comes from the vendored Assessment Objectives sheet. Omit ao_id when that sheet has no row. framework_hops are copied only from beacon/scf/offline control JSON. A pass of a rule is not a satisfied objective.

rules.name: tf-encryption-at-rest
rules.gap: The rule checks that storage encryption is present. CRY-07_A07 asks for organization-defined types. That row stays off ao_id until the rule names those types. The offline slice title for CRY-07 is Encrypting Data At Rest.

rules.name: tf-no-public-acl
rules.gap: The objective says system access is limited to authorized users. It does not name an S3 ACL. IAC-02 objectives describe the IAM program. They are not this rule. The offline slice has no IAC-25.json, so this rule has no framework_hops. IAC-25_A01 can be a later ao_id when the rule checks an approved authorization on each allow.

rules.name: tf-required-logging
rules.gap: The objective says audit records for the selected event types are generated. This rule checks that a logging resource is in the same file. It does not select event types. aws.lake.logs seals IAC-02. That collector target is not this map. The offline slice has no MON-04.json, so this rule has no framework_hops.

rules.name: tf-no-plaintext-secrets
rules.gap: The objective says software artifacts are scanned for plain text or encoded secrets and keys. IAC-53_A03 is a real row for CAA automated-identity credentials. This rule cannot tell a CAA credential from another secret, so that ao_id stays unset. The offline slice has no CFG-17.2.json, so this rule has no framework_hops. .tfvars files are a later where glob.
